Jordan (Sales): FYI — delivering the red-team engagement summary + artifacts for the ACME SOC review. Please check before I upload the customer package. S3 link (internal): s3://redwood-evidence/red-team/engagement-2026-03-18/
Alyssa (Sales): Thanks. Does that package include PoC exploits or only logs/screenshots? Need to know what we can share with legal. :thinking_face:
Emma (Security): It contains both raw and a sanitized bundle. Raw PoCs are in the internal-only folder, sanitized artifacts in `shareable/` with exploit steps redacted. We should only share `shareable/` with ACME.
Sam (Eng): Quick owner mapping below — pulled from the ticket tracker.
Sam (Eng): - FIND-001 (RCE via upload): owner=@sam, patch ETA ~7d, workaround: upload size restriction + content-type validation.
Sam (Eng): - FIND-007 (auth bypass by session fixation): owner=@emma? actually security will own rollout of mitigation, eng to implement token rotation. ETA ~14d.
Emma (Security): Correction: FIND-007 owner is me for mitigations and sam for the code changes. I'll coordinate a retest once patched.
Jordan (Sales): Can we agree on remediation SLA for the contract? ACME asked for timeline we can commit to in the SOW. What are our proposed SLAs by severity?
Emma (Security): Proposed SLAs (internal suggestion): Critical: 14 business days, High: 30 business days, Medium: 60 business days, Low: 90 business days. For critical issues we can offer an accelerated fix runway if they sign the dedicated support addendum.
Alyssa (Sales): ACME is pushing for 10 business days on critical. Is that feasible with a dedicated patch team + hotfix?
Sam (Eng): 10 business days for Critical would require a hotfix branch and 24/7 rotation. Can do for 1-2 criticals if prioritized — need explicit sign-off and potential cost add-on.
Emma (Security): We can commit to 10 business days for Critical if they accept the hotfix SOW. We'll flag blockers that require infra changes separately.
Jordan (Sales): OK — I'll propose: Critical 10bd with hotfix SOW, High 20bd, Medium 45bd, Low 90bd. Put that in the SOW draft.
Emma (Security): Evidence package contents (shareable):
- summary.pdf (executive summary, redacted PoC descriptions)
- findings.csv (id,severity,short_desc,owner,eta)
- screenshots/
- sanitized-logs/ (stack traces redacted)
- remediation-playbooks/ (recommended fixes + configuration snippets)
Vendor-risk-bot: automated-scan: external-vuln-scan completed 2026-03-17. Results attached to internal/raw/sast-scan.json
Jordan (Sales): I'm attaching the sha256 for the shareable bundle so SOC can verify integrity before downloading:
```
sha256: 3b7f6e8a9c4f2e5a9d8b1f4c7e0d2a9c6e4b3a1f0d9c8b7e6a5f4c3b2a19087
```
Alyssa (Sales): Legal wants confirmation that PoCs in `shareable/` do not contain exploit code or server-side payloads. Emma, can you sign-off with a short note we can paste into the email?
Emma (Security): Signed-off. Paste: "I confirm artifacts in `shareable/` are sanitized and do not contain working exploit payloads or live shellcode. Full raw PoCs are internal-only and require OTT approval for external disclosure." — Emma (Security)
Sam (Eng): Quick PRs for critical fixes: PR#5321 (upload validation) target deploy to canary in 4d: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5321
Sam (Eng): I'll also tag patch owners in the ticket system.
Jordan (Sales): Timeline checklist before ACME handoff:
- [ ] Emma to produce sanitized bundle (today)
- [ ] Sam to open PR + CI run (by EOD)
- [ ] Security review sign-off (Emma) (within 24h)
- [ ] Sales to update SOW with 10bd critical hotfix clause (Jordan)
- [ ] Upload shareable bundle to ACME S3 link and send signed note (Alyssa)
Alyssa (Sales): On it — I'll wait for Emma's sign-off then send. Prefer a short email: attach summary.pdf + findings.csv + signed note + timeline.
Emma (Security): Signed and uploaded sanitized bundle to `s3://redwood-evidence/shareable/engagement-2026-03-18/` — leaving a readme.txt with redaction notes.
Jordan (Sales): Great. After Alyssa sends, can we offer a 10-day independent retest window for ACME? They asked to confirm retest cadence.
Emma (Security): We can offer one free retest within 10 business days after remediation for the items in scope. Additional retests billed per SOW.
Sam (Eng): I'll add monitoring hooks so we can validate the fix in canary before prod rollout.
Alyssa (Sales): Email going out in ~30m after I attach artifacts. Will update thread with ACME response. :mailbox_with_mail:
Jordan (Sales): Thanks all — close loop once ACME confirms.
vendor-risk-bot: noted: evidence-package uploaded to `shareable/` and audit log generated (audit-id: AR-20260318-77).
Emma (Security): tagging @sam for follow-through on PR testing. If anything blocks the CI, call me ASAP.
Sam (Eng): Will do.
Jordan (Sales): Thread done for now — will reopen if ACME requests raw PoCs or deeper evidence.
